name: io.github.jarmstrong158/agentsync-remote
title: agentsync (remote)
description: Self-hosted Cloudflare Worker remote transport for agentsync (streamable-HTTP). Speaks MCP protocol revision 2026-07-28 and is dual-era: modern clients declare their version per request in _meta, and handshake-era clients are still served, so an existing connector keeps working. Stateless by design - no session id, no server-initiated stream.

account.description: Your Cloudflare account subdomain (the 'x' in x.workers.dev); edit the URL if you use a custom domain.

token.description: Your Worker AUTH_TOKEN (set as a Worker secret at deploy time). It is the path credential; keep it private.
